subject: Bridgepoint: mid-cycle OKR pulse, scope adjustments & dependency asks
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwoodinference.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com, monica_patel@redwoodinference.com, markus_klein@redwoodinference.com
Cc: 
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Bridgepoint: mid-cycle OKR pulse, scope adjustments & dependency asks

Team —

Quick mid-cycle pulse for the Bridgepoint engagement and a few asks before QBR prep next week. I attached the working OKR workbook and a short dependencies memo. High level: the account is healthy but we need two unblockers to hit the model-latency objective for their pilot (OKR B-2).

1) Status highlights (see tab "Pulse"):
- On track: demo cadence and stakeholder alignment; pilot contract signed for the dev environment.
- Risk: Model serving latency 20–30% above SLA during synthetic load tests. That maps to our serving runtime kernel selection on smaller sequence lengths.
- Cost: projected token unit cost is within expected range once caching is applied; we still need throughput improvements to hit the target.

2) Proposed re-scope (targeted, not blanket):
- Move strict 200ms p90 latency target to a phased SLO: 200ms for interactive routes, 350ms for batch sync routes for the pilot. This buys runway for two kernel/quantization experiments.

3) Dependency asks (what I need from you by EOD Monday):
- Laura: coordinate with Solutions on the pilot test plan and confirm which endpoints are interactive vs batch.
- Vivek: authorize an experiment window on Dedicated pool during our synthetic run (2 hours of isolated load) — we need to test the new kernel selection.
- Monica: prepare a short note for the customer that explains proposed phased SLOs and why it reduces risk (aim for < 100 words).
- Markus: estimate engineering runway (FTE days) to run the kernel + quantization trial and fallback path.

Next steps: I’ll consolidate replies into an action plan and share a one-pager for the QBR on Monday. If we can get the Dedicated window and the customer note confirmed, we’ll be in good shape.

Aditya Rao
Head of Customer Success, Redwood Inference
aditya@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0182

Attachments: Q2_Bridgepoint_OKR_pulse.xlsx (workbook), Bridgepoint_DEP_MATTERS.pdf (dependency memo)
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com, monica_patel@redwoodinference.com, markus_klein@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Bridgepoint: mid-cycle OKR pulse, scope adjustments & dependency asks

Thanks Aditya — I pulled the interactive endpoint list from the Solutions tracker and marked three endpoints as interactive (chat, session-gen, prompt-complete). I’ll align with Solutions to finalize the pilot test plan today and will drop the link into the Drive doc you sent.

I agree with the phased SLO approach; it’s defensible for the pilot and lets us prioritize quick wins for interactive traffic. I’ll also draft the customer note (100 words) and share for review by Monday 9am PT.

Laura
Director, Solutions Engineering, Redwood Inference

Subject: Fwd: Bridgepoint: mid-cycle OKR pulse, scope adjustments & dependency asks

Folks — looping the customer and their CloudOps contact with the proposed phased SLO and schedule for the Dedicated experiment. Natalie — quick ask: can your CloudOps team confirm Monday 10–12 PT for the pilot load window? We’ll limit the experiment to dev/stage only and provide detailed run steps.

Below is Laura's one-paragraph note for the customer (draft) — open to edits: 

"Thanks, Natalie. To reduce launch risk we propose a phased SLA for the pilot: interactive routes targeted at 200ms p90 and batch routes at 350ms p90, with a short Dedicated pool experiment to validate kernel changes and KV-cache warmup. We will keep the current kernel pinned as a rollback option to avoid regressions. If that works we can proceed with the Monday window."

Natalie / ops — can you confirm? If we get a yes, Vivek will provision the window and Markus will finalize the FTE estimate.

Thanks all,
Aditya
